title: Japan’s floating solar farm faced Typhoon Faxai; modules broke loose and 50 panels caught fire
summary_full: In 2019, a severe typhoon struck Japan's largest floating solar farm, leaving it heavily damaged. This event highlighted the engineering flaws present in floating solar structures when confronted with extreme weather. Investigators identified anchor failures as the main factor contributing to the significant damage. In response, the project was restructured into smaller, more resilient floating modules. Now, it serves as a reference for enhancing solar technology's storm resilience.
